actual_refusal_probe: In native mode, submit two structurally accepted HIA u64 programs with add.wrap changed to sub.wrap to the existing translation validator. Require a real Z3 SAT counterexample replayed by the HIA interpreter; retain the receipt, charge actual observed proof-attempt time, then replan the same successor with every controller and both native arms.
same_information: All controllers receive every preparation, holding, memory, status and future batch estimate.
combined_static_control: Every feasible prepared subset is allowed; acquire it at the first batch and retain it.
strongest_control: Independent exact resource DP and complete subset-sequence oracle, including all value ties.
native_scope: The actual pinned original recursive-utility evaluator ranks supplied paths. The refusal probe executes the existing HIA verifier/solver/interpreter, but no successful generated native application is benchmarked.
cost_accounting: Keep modeled nanoseconds separate from actual source admission, construction, controller, process startup, identity checks, IPC, response checks, shutdown and build wall times.
failed_attempts: Retain failed attempts and partial evidence; native absence or failure never falls back to a Python imitation.
unsupported_enumeration: Reject the entire uncompressed request above the original path bound; retain the refusal and its measured cost.
formal_source_gate: Exact clean committed HEAD before and after; bind the protocol and every declared local compiler/transport input.
